chapter: 營業規章 第五章 違規用電 (108/2/18 text, not amended since)

clauses.reason: Taipower may inspect premises for 違規用電
what counts as 違規用電

clauses.summary: 違規用電之追償按供電時間及電價計算三個月以上一年以下之電費
clauses.reason: 追償電費 for 違規用電 is damages worked from appliance capacity and assumed hours of use, charged apart from a bill; calculate_bill bills metered usage

clauses.summary: 追償電價按追償期間之臨時電價計算，不予優待或折扣
clauses.reason: 追償電費 for 違規用電 is damages worked from appliance capacity and assumed hours of use, charged apart from a bill; calculate_bill bills metered usage
Taipower may stop supply and sue for 違規用電
